description:
Episode 1

Osananajimi no Tadashii Kaikata
The story of 2 brothers who share a sexual relationship with a childhood friend.

Doutei Otoko to Toramimi Onna
The story of a student council president who wants a loyal pet.

Episode 2

Tourou no Su
This is a slightly dark story, the unexpected ending of a mother who tries to be acknowledged by his adopted son makes the last part of the story more meaningful than its beginning.

(Source: Translated and Edited from Nekopoi)
